market_view: Risk-on into today's open (STOXX50 +2.23%, VIX 35.89 to 26.62 on Huang's return to Nvidia) while commodities slide: Brent -3.03% to 86.66 on US-Iran diplomacy, copper -1.87%, gold -0.71%. lessons.rule: Hypothesis (3 cases, does not change calls): up calls whose catalyst is an already-published or secondary-source company event, made into a falling market, have lost money.
lessons.evidence: IFX.DE long stopped out -9.88% (record quarter, guidance); shadow BP.L up 5d -0.18% wrong; shadow STMPA.PA up 5d -2.38% wrong. Shadow GSK.L up 5d -3.08% wrong is a related up-call loss but its catalyst was a primary litigation event, so not counted.
